name: Breakdown: See the Physics
subtitle: Trick shots, see the physics
promotional_text: Pool, but every shot comes with the physics behind it. Slow it down, rewind your miss, and watch exactly why the ball went where it did.
description:
Pool that shows its working.

Every shot in Breakdown comes with the physics behind it. Take the cue, hit the ball, then watch it happen in slow motion while the table explains itself.

Make the break. Hit it harder, add a little spin, and see how one small change ripples across the whole table.

WHAT YOU GET

• The Physics Lens: switch it on and see every ball's path. Amber for sliding, cyan for rolling, thicker for faster.
• Plain-words captions: every collision gets a card that says what just happened, with the numbers behind it.
• Scrub through any shot: slow it down, pause it, and move through it at your own pace.
• Try again and compare: rewind your own miss, change the spin or the aim, and see exactly what was different.
• Real spin and aim: drag on the table, pull back for power, and touch the cue ball to add follow, draw or side.
• Built for everyone: VoiceOver, larger text and fine sliders for the precise shot.

Pool, but nerdier. We mean that as a compliment.

Breakdown runs on an exact physics solver, so the same shot always gives the same result. Nothing is faked and nothing is random unless you change it.
